NOTICE OF DECISION
This direct appeal of the Taxpayer’s Petition for Review of the 2023-2024 and
2024-2025 Unsecured Tax Roll came before the State Board of Equalization (“State
Board”) for hearing on September 29, 2025.
The Respondent presented the State Board with a signed Stipulation from the
Taxpayer for review and approval by the State Board. The Stipulation was signed by
Taxpayer and the Respondent on July 9, 2025.
The parties agree to the following:
The Personal Property Tax shall be revised as follows:
Roll: 2024 - 2025 Original Taxable Value Revised Taxable Value
Personal Property $1,425,689 $1,294,893
Roll: 2023 - 2024 Original Taxable Value Revised Taxable Value
Personal Property $1,149,346 $1,120,762
Roll: 2022 - 2023 Original Taxable Value Revised Taxable Value
Personal Property $986,451 $957,156
Roll: 2021 - 2022 Original Taxable Value Revised Taxable Value
Personal Property $1,611,302 $1,577,823

DECISION
The State Board, having considered the signed Stipulation, voted unanimously to
approve the Stipulation presented. The taxable value for the property subject to the direct
appeal for the 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024, and 2024-2025 Roll shall be revised
as set forth in the Stipulation.
24
November
BY THE STATE BOARD OF EQUALIZATION this _____ day of _____________, 2025.
